mechanism: Sacubitril increases bradykinin levels via neprilysin inhibition, while donepezil increases acetylcholine via cholinesterase inhibition, both potentially enhancing parasympathomimetic effects and causing bradycardia/hypotension.
action: Monitor heart rate and blood pressure closely; consider ECG monitoring in patients with cardiac conduction abnormalities; dose adjustment may be needed if symptomatic bradycardia or syncope develops.
